name: Evergreen Steel Corp.
summary: Evergreen Steel Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the steel structure engineering and environmental protection businesses in Taiwan. The company offers construction and engineering services for factories, high-rise, bridges, and special buildings; manufacturing and assembly of steel structures; and maintenance and repair of containers. It is also involved in general and business waste treatment, disposal, and cogeneration; resource recycling; industrial water, wastewater, tap water, pure water, and sewage treatment; operation of multi-functional biomass energy center; and general investment activities.
